pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with high-frequency serrated edges and sharp angular gradients. Patch size transitions from larger, more cohesive blocks on the upper flank to smaller, fragmented shapes on the lower torso.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways with variable width. Junction nodes consist of high-density intersections forming a non-linear topological graph across the lateral surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible mane along the upper neck and shoulder transition characterized by a short, dense, and uniform jagged silhouette with consistent amplitude.
